title: solidago virgaurea subsp. macrorhiza
intro: Solidago virgaurea subsp. macrorhiza, commonly known as Large-leaved Goldenrod, is a plant species within the Asteraceae family. This perennial herb is known for its health benefits, particularly in treating digestive issues, and its therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Solidago virgaurea subsp. macrorhiza include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties. Traditional use of the plant has also led to the discovery of its potential in supporting the immune system and reducing inflammation.
